name: ctx-bytes-guard
description: Compacta sozinho quando o contexto passa de 50% ou o payload da conversa passa de 16 MB. Com o synapse-rate-limit instalado, os limites aparecem na linha dos MB.

maxMb.title: Compact at (MB)
maxMb.description: Compact when the conversation payload reaches this many MB (also when the context reaches 50%)
